quote: You search for peace in familiar places, but silence reveals the heaviest truths. Every heavy memory leaves behind a quiet echo. You try to outrun the shadow of yesterday. The past waits patiently for you to turn. Running only makes the distance feel much wider. Healing begins when you finally stop to listen.
